text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower stops coming to training sessions, declaring that she's quitting the team because she doesn't want to be a burden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This incident causes the team to realize how they shouldn't have been suppressing their individuality in order to keep the peace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While trying to convince Rice Shower to rejoin the team, Matikanefukukitaru proposes it would be lucky for them to run all the way to a distant beach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower puts a stop to this idea, thus cementing her importance as the team's voice of reason. This helps her regain her confidence.
